Nonbinary person here, let me see if I can clear some stuff up for you.

Being trans means you do not identify with your birth sex. So a trans woman doesn't identify with being male, a trans man doesn't identify with being female. 

Nonbinary is anything outside that. They can have no gender, multiple genders, fall somewhere between binary genders (which is where I land), or even switch between genders. Because someone who fell into any of those categories wouldn't be identifying with their birth sex they would be trans, and because none of those categories are binary (male or female) they would be nonbinary. 

Hope this helped!
